newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index sets 10th record close this year.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index sets 10th record close this year.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks powered to their 10th record close so far this year Tuesday as Wall Street took comfort from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's remarks about the economy.
Investors also cast an optimistic eye towards International Business Machines Corp.'s earnings, due after the close.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 40.03 points at 6,883.90, beating Monday's high of 6,843.87. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on heavy volume of 573 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
